glosses: galaxy (set of a very large number of stars, other celestial bodies, cosmic dust and gas, with a spiral, elliptical or irregular shape, animated by movement and expansion, which constitutes an astral system)

examples.en: There are many galaxies in the universe.

examples.text: Conhecemos mais de 100 bilhões de galáxias.
examples.en: We know of more than 100 billion galaxies.
There are many galaxies in the universe.
How many galaxies are there in the universe?

examples.text: Nossa galáxia se chama Via Láctea.
examples.en: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way.
